subject: Coffee & Tea
title: Thai Iced Tea
description: A quick win: understand Thai Iced Tea.

hook.text: Thai iced tea is shockingly orange. The vivid color comes from food coloring added to strongly brewed Ceylon tea.

buildup.text: The tea is brewed with star anise, crushed tamarind, and sometimes vanilla—then sweetened heavily with condensed milk.

discovery.text: It's poured over crushed ice and often served in a plastic bag with a straw at Thai street markets.

twist.text: Thai iced tea's recipe was influenced by Chinese immigrants to Thailand who adapted local flavors to familiar tea brewing.

climax.text: Today it's served in Thai restaurants worldwide as a signature drink—instantly recognizable by its electric orange hue.

punchline.text: Orange, sweet, iced, and unmistakable. Thailand's tea needs no introduction.

quiz.question: What gives Thai iced tea its distinctive orange color?
options: Food coloring added to strongly brewed Ceylon tea

details.summary: Thai iced tea is a vibrant orange drink made from strongly brewed Ceylon tea mixed with star anise, orange blossom water, and sweetened condensed milk over ice. Its distinctive color comes from added food coloring or natural tamarind. It is a staple of Thai restaurants and street food globally.
details.whyItMatters: Thai iced tea shows how a simple drink can become a global ambassador for a national cuisine. Its unique flavor and look are instantly recognizable and widely loved.
takeaways: Thai iced tea gets its orange color from food coloring or tamarind
It blends Ceylon tea with star anise and condensed milk
It has become globally recognized through Thai restaurants

faq.question: Why is Thai iced tea orange?
faq.answer: The bright orange color comes from food coloring added to the tea mix, or in more traditional versions from tamarind seed. The color has become so iconic that it is now a defining characteristic. Without it, the drink would be brown, losing its visual identity.

faq.question: What tea base is used for authentic Thai iced tea?
faq.answer: Traditional Thai iced tea uses a specific Thai tea mix that combines Ceylon black tea with star anise, crushed tamarind, and sometimes vanilla. The mix is brewed very strong, sweetened with sugar and condensed milk, and poured over ice. Many restaurants use pre-mixed Thai tea powder.
